dina_sec: Customer asks for a compact evidence packet showing which KMS keys serviced their tenant and proof that key use correlates with tenant-id labels. Need 14-day window.
sam_ops: We have a repeatable flow: export KMS events -> normalize to ndjson -> gzip -> sha256 -> sign. Quick commands (GCP):
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND labels.tenant_id="TENANT-789" AND timestamp>="2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"' --format=json > t789.kms.ndjson
jq -c . t789.kms.ndjson | gzip > t789.kms.ndjson.gz
sha256sum t789.kms.ndjson.gz > t789.kms.sha256
gpg --local-user evidence@redwood --output t789.kms.sha256.sig --armor --detach-sign t789.kms.sha256
```
dina_sec: also need mapping between service account and tenant. Where's canonical export?
sam_ops: tenant_registry export CSV lives in infra-exports. I can snapshot a read-only CSV and include it. It includes tenant_id, service_account_email, created_at.
legal_kate: legal reminder: if the service account is Redwood-managed, redact email or provide hashed form. If customer-managed, ok to include full email. Also include a short DPA reference in the packet.
oncall_ray: created ticket SLE-EVID-13422 and set me as approver. I'll pin artifacts to secure-bucket://evidence/tenant789/7071234567/.
evidence-bot: Playbook: attach (1) artifact sha256, (2) signer identity, (3) approver ticket id, (4) original export query.
dina_sec: vuln note: CVE-2026-0100 affected an old KMS client in some edge nodes; we backported fix in runtime-2.3.0. Include release note + CHANGES entry.
sam_ops: RBAC change: limited svc acct to kms.Encrypt,kms.Decrypt; removed iam.tokenCreator. PR #4721. Here's the condensed audit snippet:
```
2026-10-05T08:11:00Z iam.bindings.update principal: serviceAccount:svc-tenant-789@redwood added: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
2026-10-05T08:11:01Z iam.bindings.remove principal: serviceAccount:svc-tenant-789@redwood removed: roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```
dina_sec: one more ask from SQ: they want a negative proof — how to show a given model request did NOT read plaintext PII. Suggestion: include KV-cache key prefixes, cache-hit logs, and the denylist scan summary. Provide sample query to search for pii labels.
sam_ops: sample negative query:
```
gcloud logging read 'labels.tenant_id="TENANT-789" AND jsonPayload.labels.pii=true' --limit=1
```
legal_kate: once security ACKs, I'll run privacy sign-off. Make sure we don't include plaintext. Any explicit plaintext exposure must be escalated and have written consent.
oncall_ray: uploaded a test bundle: secure-bucket://evidence/tenant789/7071234567/t789-kms-20261001-1015.gz, sha256: d4c3b2a1f0e9d8c7b6a5e4d3c2b1a0f9e8d7c6b5a4f3e2d1c0b9a8f7e6d5c4b3, sig: t789-kms.sha256.sig (signed by evidence@redwood). Ticket SLE-EVID-13422 updated.
dina_sec: I'll draft the SQ response package: items = export + sha256 + sig, tenant_registry CSV, RBAC PR link, runtime patch evidence, negative-access paragraph, legal approval note.
sam_ops: I'll attach the tenant_registry snapshot to the ticket and redact internal-only svc accts per legal.
legal_kate: ACK pending final verifications.
evidence-bot: Reminder: mark SLE-EVID-13422 evidence-ready only after both security and legal ACK.
dina_sec: thanks team, leaving artifacts in ticket. Closing thread after final ACK. :white_check_mark:
